g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'UK primary balance vs previous-year debt, by period. Red line = fitted response. Upward slope = debt-stabilising. The slope flattens after the 1970s and turns negative since 2000.'

text.tspan: UK primary balance vs previous-year debt, by period. Red line = fitted response.
Upward slope = debt-stabilising. The slope flattens after the 1970s and turns negative since 2000.
